grounding.states: lowest 5-year fixed insured (high-ratio) rate is 4.34%, as of Oct 12, 2026 (Ratehub) and Oct 9 (WOWA)
grounding.from: Ratehub says as of October 12, 2026, the lowest high-ratio 5-year fixed rate is 4.34%; WOWA, as of Oct 9, says the lowest 5-year fixed insured rate is 4.34%

grounding.states: lowest 5-year fixed conventional rate is 4.44%, as of Oct 9
grounding.from: WOWA, as of Oct 9, says the lowest 5-year fixed conventional rate is 4.44%

grounding.states: Big 6 bank average 5-year fixed rate is 5.17%, as of Oct 9
grounding.from: nesto's Oct 9 page lists a Big 6 Bank average 5-year fixed of 5.17%

grounding.states: fixed rates are climbing again this month (October 2026)
grounding.from: Fixed rates are climbing again in October 2026, after all 6 of the largest banks raised select fixed rates since early September

value.answer: It depends on your down payment and lender, but the lowest 5-year fixed I'm seeing in Canada is about 4.34% for insured mortgages (under 20% down), and about 4.44% for conventional ones. Big banks average around 5.17%. Rates have been climbing again this month.
